name: claude-free-code-local
description: Workspace coding MCP: files, Git, approved commands, tasks, undo snapshots and local dashboard. No API key.
long_description: Provides local coding tools in Claude Desktop, including project search, guarded file editing, Git operations, build/test commands with local approval, task checkpoints and a private browser dashboard. It does not unlock paid Claude Code or remove free tier limits.

project_root.title: Carpeta del proyecto
project_root.description: Selecciona la carpeta local que Claude puede inspeccionar y editar. No selecciones toda la unidad C: ni tu carpeta personal.
